an identity assigned as new must not already name something else
a binding identity is domain-qualified, family-prefixed and versioned

params.detail: binding code {value!r} must be domain::FAMILY_NAME_V<n>

rule_set.intent: an artifact carried over from the composition must really be in it
a design amends only what it could have authored

params.detail: amends {value!r}, whose family this design cannot author — an amended artifact is rendered whole, so this schedules a document to be rewritten from registers that never held its content. The governance surface is authored, not constructed: cite it with REUSE or REVIEW, and deliver the change by authoring it

rule_set.intent: a design replaces only what it could have authored

params.detail: replaces {value!r}, whose family this design cannot author — a replacement is a rendering like any other. The governance surface is authored, not constructed

rule_set.intent: a workflow in the topology is one this design declared or carried over
every node in the topology is an identity this design actually assigned

params.detail: a binding identity is immutable, so a spelling variant is a second artifact rather than a synonym

rule_set.intent: a runtime binding binds a workflow that exists in this design
a runtime binding is itself a declared artifact, never implicit
a composition belongs to a capability contract this design declared
a step invokes a capability that is declared new or carried over, never invented inline
an outcome the operation cannot answer names the transform that produces it

params.detail: branches on {outcomes}, which {operation} does not answer — it answers {answers}. An outcome the store cannot produce comes from an interpretation, and this step names none, so the branch is a decision nothing makes

rule_set.intent: an interpretation names the outcome it yields, closing the route

params.detail: routes on {outcomes} and declares no semantic status — {operation} answers {answers}, so the outcome routed on is an interpretation's, and the workflow branch it feeds has nothing declared to route on

rule_set.intent: a step addresses a store exactly when its capability keeps one

params.detail_missing: names no store on {capability}, which keeps records — a storage step that addresses nothing is a read or a write with no subject
params.detail_spurious: names a store on {capability}, which keeps none — the step addresses records that capability has no way to hold

rule_set.intent: a step consuming nothing invokes an operation that takes nothing

params.detail: consumes nothing and invokes {operation}, which accepts {accepts} — the operation receives no value for what it takes, and the step reports success on having addressed nothing

rule_set.intent: every reach an act declares is used by a read that act performs

params.detail: declares a reach to {binding} and reads nothing it covers — that binding answers for {stores}, and no step this act runs addresses any of them. A permission granted for nothing is one whose purpose nobody reviewed

rule_set.intent: an act reads nothing it did not declare a reach to

params.detail: reads {store}, which {binding} does not cover and no declared reach names — the act reaches records another part of the business owns and its design does not say so, which is invisible until the act runs

rule_set.intent: an act reaching into another subdomain reads what it holds and never changes it
the transform that turns an observation into a decision is itself governed

params.detail: an interpreting transform is an artifact like any other, declared or carried over

rule_set.intent: a vocabulary states what it extends, or states that it extends nothing

params.detail: vocabulary says nothing about what it extends — a base vocabulary declares that with the none marker, because an empty cell and an omission render the same thing

rule_set.intent: a declared store says where it will live

params.detail: store declares no proposed path — a store nobody can locate is not designed

rule_set.intent: a dependency declared satisfied by an existing artifact must be inventoried as reuse
a capability the business asked for and the design never bound is declined, not deferred
an artifact the design authors is one the business asked for, never one it invented
a workflow with no declared graph is a workflow construction would have to invent
a workflow with no runtime binding cannot resolve the capabilities it composes
a capability contract with no declared pipeline specifies nothing to build
a transform is the one family that points outside the composition; the path is designed, not discovered
an artifact this design replaces is named by whatever supersedes it
a vocabulary states the group its values belong to

params.detail: vocabulary names no group for its values — the renderer would supply one, and it supplies the same one to every vocabulary whatever the values mean

rule_set.intent: a vocabulary states the spelling its values take

params.detail: vocabulary names no spelling for its values — the renderer would supply one, and a spelling its values do not have is refused by the platform that reads them

rule_set.intent: a vocabulary that declares no value admits nothing
a binding belongs to a workflow or contract this design declared
a field belongs to an artifact this design declared
a binding reads a field the operation yields, never one it was hoped would exist
a step invokes an operation the capability offers, never one it was assumed to have
a step hands an operation fields it accepts, never ones it was hoped would exist
a declared implementation says where it lives

params.detail: transform names no module — an implementation nobody can locate is not designed

rule_set.intent: a transform's module is where its domain resolves implementations, named for the artifact
a transform says how it expresses a judgement about its subject

params.detail: transform declares no refusal — whether a judgement is raised or returned is the one fact that says if a step routing on it can ever fail, and both look the same from outside

rule_set.intent: refusal is one of the three the composition can act on

params.detail: refusal is {value!r}; a transform raises its judgement, returns it, or makes none, and the schema admits nothing else

rule_set.intent: an interpretation can fail, or the branch it feeds is unreachable
a transform is entered the one way every transform is entered

params.detail: callable is {value!r}; every transform in the composition is entered through `execute`, and a loader given another name finds nothing

rule_set.intent: every declared input names where its value comes from

params.detail: field is bound to nothing — construction would have to choose a source

rule_set.intent: a store is named for the format its capability actually writes
a source that names a place is rooted in one execution scope actually offers
a workflow hands a contract everything that contract says it requires
a source that names another node must name one this workflow reaches
a transform handed an input it does not declare receives nothing under that name
a binding outside the interface feeds a capability input that does not exist
a capability handed no value for an input it declares receives a null
a reference the runtime cannot resolve is indistinguishable from one it can

params.detail: an output is written to capability_result.<field> or result_status; an input reads inputs.<field>, payload.<field>, results.<step>.<field>, or is a literal

rule_set.intent: a declared output no step emits gives every caller a name that resolves to nothing
provenance belongs to an artifact the design actually declares

params.detail: provenance is stated about an artifact this design neither authors nor carries over — a generator for something nothing schedules produces nothing

rule_set.intent: one artifact, one producer, so agreement with the generator means something

params.detail: {value} is generated twice, first at row {first} — an artifact has exactly one producer, and two producers of one truth drift

rule_set.intent: a generated artifact names what produces it

params.detail: artifact is declared generated and names no generator — construction has nothing to invoke and no way to reach it

rule_set.intent: a generator is invocable from the composition, not only by a person at a terminal

params.detail: generator {value!r} must be module:callable — construction imports its generator and a script it can only shell out to is one nothing governs

rule_set.intent: a generator is its sources together, so a change to either is a change to it

params.detail: generator names no sources — a template and the declaration read with it are one generator, and naming neither permits regenerating from a stale pairing

rule_set.intent: every refusal the business declared is carried out here or owned by someone else
a discharge answers a refusal the business declared, never one the design invented
a deferral hands on a refusal the business declared, never one nobody approved
a deferred refusal names who will carry it out

params.detail: names no owner — a refusal handed on to nobody is a refusal dropped in language that sounds like a plan

rule_set.intent: the governance surface is cited for a refusal the business declared, never for one it did not
a cited rule is located in the phase whose rule set holds it

params.detail: {value!r} is not a phase — a rule is named by its phase and its identifier together, written p0 through p8, because an identifier alone names nine rules

rule_set.intent: a governance-surface discharge names the rule that refuses

params.detail: cites no rule — a refusal said to be carried out by the governance surface and naming nothing there is prose, and prose refuses nothing

rule_set.intent: a rule said to carry out a refusal is really in force where the design is pinned
a discharge names a step the act has and an outcome that step reports
the outcome a discharge names stops the act rather than continuing it
a moment is announced from an ending the act has, and one that completes it
an act announces a moment that exists, never one nothing declares

params.detail: an announced moment must be an identity this design declares

rule_set.intent: an event names an occurrence, and a code in the imperative names an operation

params.detail: {value!r} does not name a moment that has happened — an event code reads EV_<subject>_<participle>, as EV_ACTOR_REGISTERED_V0 does

rule_set.intent: an unanswered question left in a register reads as decided to every later phase

params.detail: {column!r} declares the question unanswered ({marker}) rather than answering it — ask it as a clarification, do not hedge it in a register

rule_set.intent: a dossier document states its phase, its CR, its lifecycle state, and what it feeds
the lifecycle axis is a controlled vocabulary, not free text
